title: Paramount Primal Developing Sci-Fi Thriller With Mysterious UAP Satellite Crashing in New Mexico Desert, Infecting All Life on Earth
description: Paramount's new smartly-budgeted genre label, Paramount Primal, is developing a sci-fi thriller with a mysterious UAP satellite crashing in the New Mexico desert. The project, which is currently in production in Mexico, follows a rapidly mutating extraterrestrial organism that infects all life on Earth, including humans, animals, and plants. The story is based on a script by Patricia A. Beninati, Michael K. Anderson, and Jeff Knight.

title: UK government rejects calls for UFO probe
description: The UK government has rejected calls for an official inquiry to look into claims of UFO activity in the skies over Scotland.

title: 'Jellyfish-Shaped UFO': Bizarre Figure Standing on Mars Surface Vanished Less Than Minute Later
description: A resurfaced NASA Curiosity rover photo has sparked fierce debate after viewers spotted a 'Jellyfish-Shaped UFO' standing on the Martian surface before vanishing seconds later.
